name: core-fast
description: The core loop without judges. Clarify, research and plan, build in parallel, then merge.

transitions.label: plan shown
transitions.when: the plan was shown and the user had a moment to object

transitions.label: all landed
transitions.when: every task of the round has landed

transitions.label: reconcile
transitions.when: the base moved or the final checks fail
transitions.then: one worker merges the base into the run and resolves conflicts, or fixes the checks

handovers.label: brief
handovers.spec: the task, its contracts, build and test commands, the landing title, extra context files

handovers.label: report
handovers.spec: done, done with limitations or failed, with what was done, where it landed, build and tests, open issues; the host says whether it landed
